Why the words you use every day matter more than you think.

Kevin Trudeau says many successful people use a set of key words, spoken out loud and in a specific order. He describes it as a ladder of internal confidence, one that moves a person from "I wish" toward having it all.

He points out you are the same person you were five years ago. The phrases you use every day run on autopilot, and you may not even realize they hold you back.

Which phrase do you say most often without thinking?

Ask a rich person how they did it, and many cannot really say.

Kevin Trudeau talks about people who build serious wealth, whether they are 25 or much older. When you sit down and ask exactly what they do, most of them don't know what they are doing.

His advice: you have to ask them very specific questions to find out.

What is the first question you would ask a successful person?
